title: After the Takarazuka Kinen: A Strong Umamusume

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho! It's Sweep Tosho! Sweep Tosho has done it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Phew!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's been thirty-nine years since we've had a winner from the Triple Tiara tour! Thirty-nine years!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho of the Triple Tiara tour has beaten out the mighty competition and taken first place at the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho was incredibly, unbelievably strong! The silence in the racecourse is deafening!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: This can't be happening… Isn't she from the… Is this even possible?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: …! Oh, right, applause! The race is over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap… Clap, clap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After an extended silence, the crowd finally applauds and cheers begin to echo throughout the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I can't help feeling that the audience's sheer disbelief only proves the magnitude of what Sweep Tosho has accomplished.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haha… Come on. Just shut up about it already…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Sweep. That was fantastic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, Rob Roy. That's a pretty brief comment from someone who loves words and books and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You can praise me some more if you like… I just fought the ultimate hero and won, after all.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, Sweep… Hehe. You're right.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: But I'm sorry. No matter how many thousands of books I read, I won't be complimenting you any more than this.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: And that's because… I'm so disappointed!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm so disappointed I don't know what to do! I didn't want to lose that race! I wanted to win!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I wanted to be the hero and plunge my blade into the heart of the witch I so admire!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I apologize. I need to go and cool my head. …Goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Whoa. Haha. When did you learn how to sound so cool?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But, y'know, the reason I had so much fun today is because I was running against you. And, thanks to you…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I pulled off my ultimate racing magic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The changes come in dribs and drabs at first, like ripples made by tiny drops.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: And it got me thinking. When I saw Sweep Tosho running that day, I thought…

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't be surprised if more and more Umamusume from the Triple Tiara tour started winning all kinds of G1 races, regardless of what year they're in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But with each passing day, the ripples grow a little bigger and spread a little further.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: I wanna watch my favorite Umamusume from the Triple Tiara tour run in the autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Or should I say, I wanna go see her win! I mean, it could happen, right?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: After that Takarazuka Kinen, I really think it's possible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And finally, the ripples build into waves that wash over the whole world.

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: And maybe—just maybe—another Umamusume on the Triple Tiara tour could…

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: One day, maybe they could match President Symboli Rudolf and her seven crowns! Or even surpass her! They could actually set a record for G1 wins! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: You can't even say it's impossible anymore. It's like the way things are has totally changed. Like all my assumptions have been smashed up.

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: Yeah… It's almost like…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "'It was almost like we were under a magic spell,' the spectators marveled."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Sweep Tosho has demonstrated that it doesn't matter whether someone hails from the Triple Crown tour or the Triple Tiara tour, because strength is strength."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "This is undoubtedly a turning point in history."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A grin spreads across her face as she finishes reading the article.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Did you hear that, Familiar?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: They said it was like magic!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She sounds confident, cheerful, and unusually innocent.
